Package shapes.utilities

Class SortUtility

java.lang.Object
shapes.utilities.SortUtility
public class SortUtility extends Object
This class: - Provides multiple sorting algorithms for Shape3D arrays - Sorts shapes in descending order based on the given Comparator - Contains only static methods (no objects of this class are created)

      public static void quickSort(Shape3D[] shapes, int count, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)

    • partition

      private static int partition(Shape3D[] shapes, int i, int j, Comparator<Shape3D> comparator)
      This method: - Partitions the array around a pivot element - Moves all values greater than the pivot to the left side - Moves all smaller values to the right side
      Parameters:
      shapes - - array being sorted
      comparator - - comparison rule used to determine ordering
      left - - starting index of the partition
      right - - ending index (pivot position)
      Returns:
      final index of the pivot element
